source_forecasts: 12 period adopted independent first-win q from original commit 8da8f4f8e1125eb522df5546d07cd6657fab7dda
first_win_model: V2 full_plus_line corrected unscaled term=999 with high-hinge theta=0.6412587661746468
fit_cohort: all 14,081 F1 S級 races with frozen win forecast, uniquely observed first and second and third, valid predicted lineup
fit_method: maximum likelihood of actual second rider given actual first and remaining lineup

direction_definition.directly_behind_winner: Same predicted line as i, j is immediately behind i in displayed order
direction_definition.ahead_of_winner: Same predicted line as i, j is ahead of i in displayed order
direction_definition.later_behind_winner: Same predicted line as i, j is at least 2 positions behind i
direction_definition.other_line: Any other rider from another line (zero offset)

parameter_identifiability: Three mutually exclusive within-line directions. No separate redundant same_line term, because same_line equals sum of those three indicators.
caveats: Full-cohort coefficients fitted and evaluated on same dataset are descriptive model-discovery results, not independent generalization evidence.
Chronological check interval has been visited by earlier research; not a globally virgin test.
Historical predicted lines and racer feature snapshots have not been certified as identical to 15-minute-before-deadline captures.
Conditional second is evaluated given known actual first. Pre-race pair probability must multiply by q_i and sum over first when necessary.
Independent q has no integrated betting-market odds; probability accuracy does not demonstrate expected wagering returns.
